batchReviews.scope: Oakland only; presentation geography. Existing URLs, canonical associations, engines and content stay owned by existing records.
batchReviews.coordinatePolicy: Existing Rofo area points are approximate orientation references with no measured accuracy; decimal places do not imply precision. batchReviews.reuse: Original factual review notes and source links only. Census geometry/geocoder output is government open data. City/BID PDF images, design, listing text and photography are not republished.

coordinateLineage.derivation: Existing authored commercial-area approximate_centroid -> _data/neighborhoodPages.js -> shared map point. No city coordinate fallback. Original surveyed/geocoder lineage and accuracy are undocumented; primary sources corroborate approximate context only.

districtPolicy: Existing public district reference coordinates only; no invented bounds. Illustration-space polygons and CSS x/y positions are excluded. Reference markers cannot establish coverage, overlaps, municipal ownership or travel times.
propertyMethod: Exact Census normalized-street/full-house-number/state/postal-city match only; range-interpolated positions are not parcel/entrance coordinates. Previously verified Phoenix municipal PointAddress records retained with their source attribution.
recheck: Recheck if the address, district association, source geometry or canonical route changes; review public geocodes and unresolved records before release. Annual source refresh is a maintenance suggestion, not a scheduled task.
